finding: Values reproduce to <=0.001 dex on every uniquely matched row, which validates the pull, the log gf = log10(gi*fik) computation, the air/vac frame and the EP-aware match. The GRADES do not: the store carries A+ (<=2%) on the O I 777 triplet where NIST ASD publishes A (<=3%). The store claims BETTER precision than the authority it cites, on the most used oxygen diagnostic in the programme -- so any gf_sigma_dex derived from that grade would be too small.
